## Data Model Mapping to Standards for Q138572983

| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| identifier                    | Q138572983                                         | **E42 Identifier** / **P1 is identified by** |
| title                         | P1476 (title)                                      | **P102 has title**                           |
| type                          | P31 (instance of)                                  | **P2 has type**                              |
| location                      | P276 (location)                                    | **P55 has current location**                 |
| start_date                    | P580 (start time)                                  | **P4 has time-span**                         |
| end_date                      | P582 (end time)                                    | **P4 has time-span**                         |
| subject                       | P921 (main subject)                                | **P129 is about**                            |
| creator *(Qualifier of P921)* | P170 (creator)                                     | **P94 has created** / **P14 carried out by** |
| related_collection            | P972 (catalog)                                     | **P67 refers to**                            |
| curator / contributor         | P1640                                              | **P14 carried out by**                       |
| official_website              | P856 (official website)                            | **P67 refers to**                            |
| website_language              | P407 (language of work or name, Qualifier of P856) | **P72 has language**                         |
